exampleNotice: ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE. Every row below is invented for public demonstration of the SCOPE workflow. These are not extracts from any real system and describe no real organisation, product or plan.
grain: One row per demand line, per plan version, per snapshot.
note: Deliberately small and hand-written so a reviewer can verify every published number by eye. Rows reproduce the worked examples in plan/metric-context/ exactly.
identity: baseline_quantity + adjustment_quantity = quantity, on every row where quantity is known.

rows.adjustment_reason: New demo customer confirmed after the baseline was frozen.
